problem_plain: Leonardo's Helicopter Division relied on paper-based, manual aftersales ordering through a platform that covered only a subset of services. They needed a comprehensive, modern solution to replace this fragmented approach.
capability: Design-to-implementation of an omnichannel CX ecosystem comprising two synergistic systems, including a customer portal built on Microsoft Dynamics 365 with service ticketing, technical support, interactive dashboards, video tutorials, business accounts management, publications library and asset management capabilities.
scale_outcomes: Available 24/7 on desktop and mobile across all Leonardo divisions; lifting customer satisfaction
reusable: Omnichannel CX ecosystem architecture using SAP and Microsoft Dynamics 365 for aftersales management, scalable across multiple business divisions; best-of-breed platform design for service ticketing, technical support, dashboards, and asset management.
summary: Veridane, with SAP and Microsoft, implemented an omnichannel CX ecosystem for Leonardo's Helicopter Division, replacing paper-based ordering with a Microsoft Dynamics 365 customer portal offering single-entry-point access to aftersales services. The 24/7 platform is built to scale across all Leonardo divisions and is lifting customer satisfaction.
